_comment: SOURCE OF TRUTH for the converter element-mapping table. Hand-curated from the Site Converter's recognizer registry (class-fw-site-converter-stitch.php) + block-builder registry (class-fw-site-converter-mapper.php, register_builder / n_* node builders), which have a PHP<->JS parity twin in the to-pages path. Edit THIS file, then run `node scripts/gen-element-mapping.mjs` to regenerate ai-dev-kit/element-mapping.md. Do NOT hand-edit the generated .md. Priority = relative evaluation order (lower runs first); specialized structural recognizers take the low numbers, these text primitives run later, and code_block (priority 99) is the universal fallback for anything unmapped.

elements.matchesWhen: A semantic heading tag (`<h1>`–`<h6>`), or a text node the heuristics score as a heading. Level ≤ 2 is treated as a page **Title** (larger Display type); level ≥ 3 as a section heading.
elements.blockShape: { t:'heading', html|text, level, align, cls, wrapCls, cs }
elements.notes: Font family / size / weight / line-height / letter-spacing / color / transform / alignment are re-asserted at specificity 0 (the "hi-fi base"), so it looks identical out of the box while staying editable through Theme Settings and the heading's own options.

elements.matchesWhen:
A paragraph / body-copy block (typically `

` or a text container) that isn't a heading, button, or other recognized primitive. Short ALL-CAPS or eyebrow/kicker-classed text is refined to an **overline** instead.
nativeOptions: **Text Style preset** (`font_size_preset`) when a body role is matched
elements.notes: Vertical margins ride the unified styler; font / color / line-height re-assert at specificity 0. When a Text Style preset is assigned, `font-size` is dropped from the base so the editable preset owns the size instead of a frozen per-node value.
